summary: Both requested gates pass here, and all 14 shipped files and manifest rows verify. The default suite requires a sibling checkout, the generator accepts an invalid file set, and the README misstates format selection.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: tests/audio-handoff.test.ts:79-88 unconditionally requires the sibling monorepo in the default suite. The standalone checkout fixture fails at the git status check. Skip that check with a reason when the sibling is absent in default mode. Keep the check mandatory in the explicit hand-off gate.

F2 [Blocker] review-a: scripts/audio-handoff.mjs:17-33,38-50 validates the counts and compares the two lists but never validates the expected names. A fixture with tap.ogg renamed to tap.wav in both folders exited 0 and labeled tap.wav as mp3. Check the approved seven names in both formats before replacing the output folder.

F3 [Blocker] review-a: scripts/audio-handoff.mjs:70-73 generates a README that says the bus chooses the format in the first unlock. Spec AC9 and src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts:258-269 allow preload to choose it earlier. State that preload can choose the format and the first unlock reuses that choice. Make the README test assert the preload exception.
nonblocking_findings: F4 [Nit] review-a: tests/audio-handoff.test.ts:167-169 accepts a numeric prefix followed by text. The flagged suite passed with junk appended to one manifest bytes cell. Compare the complete cell to the decimal file size.

F5 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:761 gives a checksum command that fails from the repo root. The checksum lists basenames, which sha256sum resolves against the current directory. Use the strategy's command that runs inside the hand-off folder.

F6 [Nit] review-a: scripts/audio-handoff.mjs:13,35-40 assumes the output ancestors are real directories. The audited checkout uses directories, but a symlink in an output ancestor can redirect writes outside the hand-off folder. Check the output directory ancestry before deleting or writing.

The generated manifest, docs row, and plan do not claim the PM confirmed the target. The output stays ignored.

ratings.evidence: All 14 shipped files verify, but the CLI accepted tap.wav as mp3 and the README omits the preload exception.
Byte changes and missing output fail, but the malformed bytes cell passes and the default run fails without a sibling checkout.
The exact phase diff adds the planned generator and test and updates only the phase plan and generated status.
Both gates, independent checksum calculations, and isolated negative fixtures produced direct results.
